overall_summary: Sample size is small (10 videos, max 33 views), so statistical confidence is low. However, hooks grounded in decisive phone actions around self-respect and moving on outperform passive waiting and tea/mood metaphors.

winning_patterns.pattern: Decisive digital action paired with self-respect themes
winning_patterns.evidence: AfaLxMy6FMY ('उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी', topic: self respect) scored the channel's highest views (33 views).
winning_patterns.action: Focus on active emotional choices (deleting, unsaving, closing chats) over passive longing.

winning_patterns.pattern: Relatable digital interaction hooks (typing, contact names, unsent drafts)
winning_patterns.evidence: A_eLARoegnw (20 views) and zL8saHvD-uI (20 views) both used specific UI-driven moments ('टाइपिंग... लिखकर डिलीट', 'फोन में नाम').
winning_patterns.action: Anchor stories around modern phone UI micro-behaviors.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic ambient metaphors without active conflict
weak_patterns.evidence: uIbMpCjVutQ ('मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई') got only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic poetic clichés like cold tea or generic night scenery without an immediate personal micro-story.

weak_patterns.evidence: WhJ-VwRa3Rg ('घंटों से वो ऑनलाइन दिख रहा है') got 6 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus from watching someone else to the protagonist taking control of their own peace.

next_video.twist_direction: Instead of playing it to relive the pain, the user swipes left and hits delete without listening, realizing peace matters more than answers.
